newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania 1997 aluminium output seen at 160,000 tns.
newsitem.headline: Romania 1997 aluminium output seen at 160,000 tns.

text.p: Romania expects to produce 160,000 tonnes of aluminium in 1997, up from 141,000 tonnes last year, a senior official said on Friday.

Ion Capota, Industry Ministry director in charge of the metallurgical sector, said January-March aluminium output totalled 36,400 tonnes, compared with 35,700 tonnes over the same period last year. Output for the year was expected to hit 160,000 tonnes, he said.
Capota said 98,000 tonnes of aluminium was exported last year with a purity of 99.99 percent.
"I think exports will remain close to last year's level," he told Reuters.
Slatina SA, Romania's only aluminium smelter near the southwestern town of Craiova, produces electrolitic and refined aluminium as well as alloys with technology from Pechiney International.
The smelter gets alumina from two plants in Oradea in northwest Romania and in the Danube port of Tulcea. The plants can produce a total of 650,000 tonnes of alumina a year.
